description.value:
Duration 1 minute

Briefly borrow your Idol's senses, seeing through it at range.

You perceive through your Idol's senses instead of your own for the duration. While you do, you are blinded and deafened with respect to your own body, and your Idol must remain within 1 mile of you. You may Dismiss this effect. Your Idol gains no ability to act while you are riding its senses; it is a window, not a hand.
